cases.name: Jessica Rose Richardson Martin
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She was Baptist by her faith, worked as an accountant, enjoyed snap chat, arts, and Alabama football." 

She had a heart as big as this world honestly and she just wanted to help people. She was a fixer and it didn’t matter what issues you had, anything that was going on in your life you could come here and she’d open the door for you, no matter what time of the night,” her younger sister Samantha Autry said.
